body:
Long continuous traces stop recording once the bundle reaches `maxBundleBytes`: every later checkpoint and mutation batch is dropped.

### Evidence (browser-commander 0.26.3; `src/traces/` is identical in 0.27.0)

A 9-hour continuous trace of an hh.ru automation run with the 256 MB default logged 15 `dropped` events with reason `size-limit`, for example:

- `mutations/0018.ndjson`: 26,380,842 bytes
- `checkpoints/0021.html`: 3,240,623 bytes

Part of the size comes from the mutation records: each attribute or live-state record carries `target.html`, up to 4000 characters of the target's outerHTML. On a busy page a single interval between checkpoints reaches 26–27 MB of ndjson.

### Suggestions

- Omit or deduplicate `target.html` in attribute and live-state records, since the path already identifies the element.
- Rotate or compress, or cap each interval with a truncation marker, instead of dropping everything once the bundle is full.
- Document the limit and what happens when it is reached.
- Add `input[type=hidden]` to `DEFAULT_REDACT_SELECTORS`: CSRF tokens in hidden inputs are kept in checkpoint HTML unless the caller adds the selector.

### Workaround in the consumer

hh-job-application-automation raises the limit to 1 GB and redacts hidden inputs in its trace options (`src/tracing.mjs`).

Related: #140
title: Long traces hit maxBundleBytes and then drop every checkpoint and mutation; mutation records repeat target outerHTML

comments.body: Still reproducible in **0.28.0**: every attribute, childList and live-state record repeats `target.html` (`page-capture.js:380-395`), giving an 8,632-byte record for one 500-character append and 424 KB for 50. The new rotation and gzip limit disk use but keep the repetition, and rotation deletes old segments (filed separately). Workaround kept: maxBundleBytes 1 GB.

`assertDedicatedUserDataDir` → `physicalPath()` (`src/browser/browser-profile-files.js:13-31`) tolerates only ENOENT/ENOTDIR. Under Bun 1.4.2 on macOS, `fs.lstatSync` and `fs.realpathSync` on `~/Library/Safari` and `~/Library/Containers/com.apple.Safari` fail with EPERM (privacy-protected), while `fs.statSync` and Node's `realpathSync` work.

### Reproduction
```sh
bun -e "import('browser-commander').then(m=>m.connectOrLaunch({userDataDir:'/tmp/x', remoteDebuggingPort:9397}))"
# EPERM: operation not permitted, lstat '/Users/<me>/Library/Safari'
```

### Expected
EPERM/EACCES are treated like an unresolvable path (keep the plain path); a Bun test covers it.

Environment: browser-commander 0.28.0, playwright 1.64.0, Bun 1.4.2, macOS, Chrome 155. Found while upgrading hh-job-application-automation (which keeps a local workaround until this is fixed).
title: connectOrLaunch with userDataDir throws EPERM under Bun on macOS (physicalPath on ~/Library/Safari)

body:
`connector.js:203-205` throws `RangeError: No tab matches the requested targetId/URL` when the remembered tab is gone; on reuse, `persistent-session.js open()` passes `metadata.targetId`. The process then never exits, because `connectPlaywright` does not close the `chromium.connectOverCDP` connection on error.

### Reproduction
`connectOrLaunch` → `detach()` → close that tab via `/json/close/<id>` → `connectOrLaunch` again: it throws and the process hangs.

### Expected
- Fall back to the visible or first tab, or open one, when the remembered tab is gone.
- Close the CDP connection on any failure.
- Allow a ranked list of URL matchers for choosing the tab.

Environment: browser-commander 0.28.0, playwright 1.64.0, Bun 1.4.2, macOS, Chrome 155. Found while upgrading hh-job-application-automation (which keeps a local workaround until this is fixed).
title: A stale remembered targetId makes connectOrLaunch throw and leak the CDP connection

body:
Three gaps for long-lived kept-open sessions:

1. **No adoption of an existing browser:** `open()` throws "Debugging port belongs to another browser/profile" when the metadata file is missing (`persistent-session.js:113-120`), so a browser the caller started earlier (or with an older version) cannot be adopted.
2. **Idle measured by navigations only:** `lastActive` updates only on `framenavigated`/`touch()`, so a controller attached for longer than the idle timeout without navigating gets its browser closed. Please also count a still-attached controller as activity.
3. **Single tab only at attach:** `singleTab` applies at attach time; please add an option to close tabs opened later.

Environment: browser-commander 0.28.0, playwright 1.64.0, Bun 1.4.2, macOS, Chrome 155. Found while upgrading hh-job-application-automation (which keeps a local workaround until this is fixed).
title: Kept-open sessions: cannot adopt a running browser, idle counts only navigations, singleTab only at attach

body:
Trace network recording leaks secrets:

- `traces/network.js:175` stores request bodies as text, `:228` stores response bodies as base64, so `privacy.redactPatterns` cannot apply to responses.
- `redaction.js:105-126` applies only patterns and the callback; no redaction of form/JSON/multipart fields by name.
- Header redaction is limited to cookie/authorization/set-cookie plus x-api-key/x-auth-token/x-csrf-token.

### Reproduction
`network: { bodies: true, har: true }` with a JSON POST `{password, _xsrf}`, a `?xsrf=` query, an `X-Xsrftoken` header and an HTML hidden token input: the values appear in `events.ndjson(.gz)`, `network.har` and `trace.lino`.

### Expected
- Redact form/JSON/multipart fields by name (password, token, csrf, xsrf, otp…).
- Store text bodies as UTF-8; skip binary bodies and record their size.
- Match header names by pattern (`*token*`, `*csrf*`, `*xsrf*`).
- Add `xsrf`/`_xsrf`/`csrf` to the default redacted query parameters and `input[type=hidden]` to the default redact selectors.

Environment: browser-commander 0.28.0, playwright 1.64.0, Bun 1.4.2, macOS, Chrome 155. Found while upgrading hh-job-application-automation (which keeps a local workaround until this is fixed).
title: Trace network leaks secrets: no field-name redaction, response bodies stored base64, narrow header list

body:
- **No redaction in DOM output:** `checkpoints.js:71-76` and `mutation-stream.js:198` write raw content; embedded `<meta name=csrf-token>` and `xsrfToken` values leak into `checkpoints/*.html`, `mutations/*.ndjson` and `trace.lino` (`dom: 'full'`). `privacy.redactPatterns`/`redact` are not applied there.
- **links.dom cost grows with the trace:** `links.js:639` calls `readTrace(bundle)` on every checkpoint and every 500 ms drain (`recorder.js:354-363`); `reader.js:161` re-reads the whole interval file; `seenDom` grows without limit (`links.js:586`); snapshots are uncapped.

### Expected
Apply redaction to checkpoints and mutation batches; append only new batches; cap snapshots and intervals with truncation markers.

Environment: browser-commander 0.28.0, playwright 1.64.0, Bun 1.4.2, macOS, Chrome 155. Found while upgrading hh-job-application-automation (which keeps a local workaround until this is fixed).
title: DOM traces: redaction not applied to checkpoints and mutations; links.dom re-reads the whole bundle every drain

With `limits.rotate: { maxBytes: 65536 }`, a 424,157-byte mutation drain was dropped and no new segment was opened: rotation only checks at 80% on a 100 ms timer (`rolling.js:64`). `maxSegments` defaults to 4 and the oldest segments are deleted (`rolling.js:9, 47-51`). The rolling handle has no `links`, and its `path` points at the root.

### Expected
- Rotate before a write that does not fit.
- Offer keep-all or compress-old retention instead of deleting.
- Return the same handle shape as `startTrace`.

`managed-navigation.js:73-90` handles only status, `isNavigationError` and TimeoutError; `net::ERR_ABORTED` is not among the `navigation-safety.js:59-90` patterns (unchanged since 0.27.0).

### Reproduction
Start `goto(A)` without awaiting it, then `goto(B)`: the first call rejects with `page.goto: net::ERR_ABORTED`. (Seen live: a page trigger and a handler both return to a list after a form is sent.)

### Expected
An "interrupted" outcome (or a navigation error that `isNavigationError` recognizes) instead of a raw error.

`page-trigger-manager.js:314-322, 361-370`: with the new default `concurrency: 'skip'`, an action that outlives the 10 s stop grace keeps the slot, so every later trigger is skipped (0.27 cleared it), and a `domcontentloaded` start that arrives while the previous action is stopping is dropped.

### Expected
- Document the change as breaking.
- Offer a per-trigger slot or a queued start.
- Tests for `restart` and this race.

body:
Browser Commander 0.28.0 fails to reconnect to an existing headed Chrome 155.0.8059.39 CDP process after its last page/window has closed. Playwright is 1.64.0.

Observed error:

```text
browserType.connectOverCDP: Protocol error (Browser.setDownloadBehavior): Browser context management is not supported.
```

The process and loopback endpoint were alive, but Target.getTargets returned an empty list. A public Playwright connectOverCDP call with noDefaults:true connected successfully. Creating one page in the existing default context restored normal Browser Commander connection; no website navigation or profile replacement was necessary.

The Browser Commander connector buildPlaywrightConnectOptions currently forwards only slowMo, timeout and headers. It does not forward noDefaults, so callers cannot select the documented Playwright option through connectBrowser.

Expected: support noDefaults forwarding and handle a still-live zero-page real-browser process without failing before a page can be created. Add a regression covering headed real Chrome reconnect with zero targets and preserve profile/window ownership.

[Playwright documented option](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browsertype#browser-type-connect-over-cdp-option-no-defaults). Our consumer adds a narrow workaround: on this exact error only, connect without default overrides, create a page only if none exists, disconnect, then reconnect through Browser Commander.

Duplicate searches for Browser.setDownloadBehavior, context management and noDefaults found no matching report; closed issue97 concerns managed downloads in non-default contexts and appears different.
title: CDP reconnect fails for zero-page headed Chrome; noDefaults option is not forwarded
